content.short: Aeroscraper is a governance-free lending protocol on Injective and Sei, offering interest-free loans via AUSD.
content.description: Aeroscraper is a user-centric, governance-free lending and borrowing protocol built on the Injective and Sei networks, offering interest-free loans to users. Borrowers pay a one-time origination fee instead of variable interest rates, minting the AUSD stablecoin by depositing assets like SEI or INJ as collateral. The protocol features a Stability Pool where users can deposit AUSD to earn rewards while providing a cushion against system shocks. Fully automated and immutable, Aeroscraper operates without admin keys, ensuring a decentralized and censorship-resistant experience for the global community.
